notes.title: Double Action: Updated Style Skills
notes.content: [p]Hello, fans of Action! For years I have had many updates I've wanted to make to Double Action. I had a week or two free while working on my other game, and I decided I wanted to use that time to check some of those items off my list. The main thing is that [b]every style skill now has a builtin passive[/b]! There are also now health bars on enemies and some reworks to Wanted and Rat Race. It's all available to play now on the default Steam branch. Check out the full changelist at the bottom of this post.[/p][p]People often ask me what I've been doing lately. The answer is [b]Eclipse Breaker[/b]! It's a combat-focused roguelike where you pick up a 25 year old save file and fight through the final dungeon of an updated JRPG. I've been putting as much effort into making a killer game as I did into Double Action, so if you remember Double Action fondly please do me the pleasure of clicking here and checking it out.[/p][p][/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2815060/Eclipse_Breaker/?utm_source=steam&utm_campaign=doubleaction"][/dynamiclink][/p][h1]Changelist[/h1][list][*][p]Every style ability now has a [b]new passive[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Updates to Bouncer:[/p][list][*][p][b]New passive[/b]: Brawling enemies grants +25 health. This effect has a 20 second cooldown, but resets if you get a kill.[/p][/*][*][p]Bouncers deal more and receive less Brawl damage (they didn't deal any more damage before even though the game said they did, oops)[/p][/*][*][p]Bouncers have a slightly higher Brawl range[/p][/*][*][p]Bouncer Brawl freezes enemy players by 50% for .35 seconds[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updates to Reflexes:[/p][list][*][p][b]New passive[/b]: Reflexes now automatically activates slowmo if you get damaged by a bullet while at full health.[/p][/*][*][p]Reflexes automatically grants one second of slowmo.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updates to Marksman:[/p][list][*][p][b]New passive[/b]: Getting a headshot on an enemy refills half of your magazine.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updates to Athletic:[/p][list][*][p][b]New passive[/b]: The player now gets a +30% style bonus while stunting.[/p][/*][*][p]Lowering the prone and slide speed boosts to 35% from 50%,[/p][/*][*][p]Lowering the slide speed boost to 15% from 25%,[/p][/*][*][p]Lowering the movement speed boost to 15% while the style skill is off but increasing it to 25% while it's on (from always 20%)[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Updates to Nitrophiliac:[/p][list][*][p][b]New passive[/b]: Hitting an enemy with a grenade slows them and momentarily reveals their position.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]You can now see enemy player health bars.[/p][/*][*][p]Health regeneration starts much quicker if there are no enemies around and regenerates your health much more quickly.[/p][/*][*][p]The Wanted now starts with a full Style Bar, which depletes over time. If it depletes then they "win" the minigame. If they get a kill then some Style is added, prolonging their time as Wanted.[/p][list][*][p]Sometimes Wanted would go a very long time if it was given to a player with a high skill differential compared to other players in the server. Now this player will have to continue to get kills if they want to extend Wanted, and either way the minigame will eventually end.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players now no longer lose progress in the Rat Race if they die.[/p][list][*][p]Sometimes Rat Race would go a very long time due to nobody being able to complete it. This was done to help ensure Rat Race ends in a reasonable amount of time.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Players now receive only 85% of the damage if they are shot in the back.[/p][/*][*][p]Style grant changes:[/p][list][*][p]Aim in bonus lowered to 10%[/p][/*][*][p]Bonuses stack additively rather than multiplicatively[/p][/*][*][p]Sliding bonus lowered to 65% from 100% since sliding is easier[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New view model and sounds for Black Magic.[/p][/*][*][p]Vote kicking players is now no longer available.[/p][list][*][p]This feature was intended to help players police hacking, but ended up being used much more often to kick high skill players.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]A new game startup song.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Shotguns would sometimes not reload if the reload was interrupted by brawling[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fix:[/b] Animation errors if you switch weapons during a grenade throw[/p][/*][*][p]A few other small bug fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h2]Linux build[/h2][p]I've been unable to get the Linux build of Double Action working on my computer, so I'm looking for anyone who is knowledgable in this area and able to compile the build for me. If you can, drop in the [url="https://discord.gg/YsxCxykMV5"]Double Action: Discord[/url] and ping me.[/p]

notes.title: Double Action: Back on the Block
notes.content:
Hello everyone! Stormy here. It has been a while. After a brief (6 year) hiatus, I have picked up development on DA again. I have just finished the first pass on all 31 of our achievements for DA and we now have a beta branch LIVE on steam where those achievements can be unlocked. I need people to get in there and test these achievements (as in, achieve them all, or find which ones are broken) before we can make them available on the public branch. There are no beta keys, no obstacles, no rules just switch your DA install to the achievements-test branch and have at it! 

There are currently 4 servers running the beta branch and you'll need to connect to them manually as they don't show in the server browser. Here are the IP's:

UPDATE: the beta server are currently down until further notice. Stay tuned!
AU server (Sydney): 45.121.211.102:10005
US server 1 (New York): 160.202.167.29:10005
US server 2 (Los Angeles): 160.202.167.29:10005
DE server (not sure just says "germany"): 203.23.178.4:10005

More info on switching to the beta branch and connecting to a dev server at the bottom of this post

Below is a list of all the achievements we need to test. Please report your findings as a reply to this thread and happy divepunching! It feels good to be BACK!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7040760/54b6b0a248eed7f38eec798d343567c92b7e00d2.png[/img]

MORE INFO:
SWITCHING TO A BETA BRANCH
In your steam library, right click on DA and go to Properties, then Betas and then select the "achievements-test" beta branch. Steam will automatically update DA with like a 5mb download.

CONNECTING TO A DEV SERVER
In order to connect manually you need to enable your developer console from the game settings so boot up DA and go to Options > Keyboard > Advanced (button down the bottom) and "Enable developer console". Then press the ~ button on your keyboard to open the console.

In the console enter "connect " and then the IP you want to connect to so if you're connecting to the LA server: connect 160.202.167.29:10005

DA COMMUNITY DISCORD
Slikktic has set up a community discord and we are currently hanging out in there. We'll be posting stuff (like this announcement) in the discord FIRST so if you want to be a part of it, lurk the server!

https://discord.gg/ygCDTRTj45

That's it! Get in there you legends!

notes.title: If you're not hearing weapon sounds at all since the update...
notes.content:
Quick info for everyone wondering why they're still not hearing weapon sounds:

We changed the way the server sends sounds to the client.
The client now ignores the old "piggy-backed" way of sending weapon sounds in order to prevent double sounds.
Servers that aren't updated yet will not send sounds in the new way, yet, which results in not being able to hear sounds at all.

So if it happens to you, find another server that is updated (see the list on the previous announcement).

notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.3.2.1
notes.content:
[quote][i]1.3.2.1 offblast![/i][/quote]
Hello everyone,

this time, there's just one change, but this one has probably been annoying most of you a lot.

The full changelog can, as always, be seen at:
https://github.com/BSVino/DoubleAction/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[h3]Weapon sounds will no longer fail to play[/h3]
Weapon sounds should now play under all circumstances.
Previously, in bandwidth-limited situations, with low rate settings or with low-end server hardware, weapon sounds didn't get transmitted to all clients.
For the longest time, I couldn't reproduce this because I have high rate settings, a fairly good internet connection and I was playing on less than full servers.
Thankfully, Dementei found some people who not only could reproduce the issue but also had the knowledge to address it.

tl;dr: Weapon sounds work now \o/
(If you still don't hear weapon sounds, make sure you're playing on an updated server)

[h2]Thanks[/h2]
[list]
[*]Valkyrie for the initial patch and for patiently debugging through this with me
[*]Joshua Ashton for helping with the initial patch
[*]Dementei and [url=https://www.twitch.tv/straychet]Stray Chet[/url] for, in one way or another, for making the connection
[/list]

[h2]What now?[/h2]
The official servers have been updated or will be updated once they have drained of players.
All other server owners have been notified about this update and will probably update their servers to the new version very soon.

The new and old versions are forwards- and backwards-compatible with one another, so you can still play on unupdated servers, but you will not hear *any* weapon sounds on unupdated servers.
Client updates are optional (but will happen automatically through Steam anyway).

Server owners will most likely need to update manually (but all players can still connect).
You will be able to find both old and new servers with both the in-game and Steam server browser.
Players can tell whether a server is updated by using the "da_version" command and verifying that the server and client have the same version (comparing the first 4 digits is enough in this case).

Servers updated so far:
[list]
[*]SimRai
[*]Superfall Boogaloo!
[*]dr.N0s
[*][ju:nien]
[*]karn's
[*]Knalltüten
[*]Minced Meat Mans
[*]OurDare
[*]RIVINS
[*]Rudeflesh
[/list]
Servers not updated:
[list]
[*]EMR (notified)
[*]Jim's (no contact info)
[*]Tuijnenburg (notified)
[*]Xerneas (notified)
[/list]
This time, due to the servers being compatible, I won't be able to easily verify which servers have updated, so I can't keep the list as up-to-date as the last time.

notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.3.2.0
notes.content:
[quote][i]How's 2021? Does it smell nice?
It smells of burnt gunpowder. Less so than the previous year, though.[/i][/quote]
Hello everyone,

the world finally made it through 2020, so here's a treat to start out the new year!

The full changelog can, as always, be seen at:
https://github.com/BSVino/DoubleAction/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md

[h2]Highlights[/h2]
[h3]Melee Rebalance[/h3]
This attempts to balance brawl-centric styles of play with other playing styles by making the following changes:
[list]
[*]Bring gun brawl (stock attack) damage down to the current level of regular melee attacks, so that you cannot 1-hit-kill people with 100% health even if you have the bouncer's melee buff unless you have a heavy weapon (Persuader/Vindicator/Black Magic).
[*]Melee attacks can now no longer be held down for more than 5 punches.
People have been abusing the full-auto nature of melee attacks using console commands and this fixes that.
[*]Style bar usage for melee attacks is now based on the damage potential of the attack.
[*]Akimbo Stallions/Sentinels now have the same melee damage as a single Stallion/Sentinel
[/list]

[h3]Diminishing certain bonuses over time[/h3]
[olist]
[*]After winning a race/dropping off a briefcase/killing the wanted, you are rewarded with a super style meter.
This meter's depletion rate is now doubled every minute.
The initial depletion rate has been halved to compensate.
[*]When chosen as the wanted, you get healed every time you kill someone.
This heal will now halve every minute.
The initial amount of healing has been doubled to compensate.
[/olist]
This will mean that even experienced players will no longer be able to hold on to these bonuses for an extreme amount of time.

[h3]No longer automatically dropping weapons to make room for weapons picked up from the ground[/h3]
This stalled people too much in case the game dropped the wrong gun. Press G to drop manually. The old behaviour can be restored with the "da_drop_overflow_on_pickup" variable.

[h2]Other changes[/h2]
[list]
[*]Add Russian translation for the menus by Louie
[*]Fix a race condition in the vote kick system allowing people to survive a kick vote by reconnecting at a certain time
[*]Make da_version_server respond in rcon properly
[*]Changed a few drums from prop_physics to prop_physics_multiplayer in order to be able to walk through them.
[/list]

[h2]What now?[/h2]
The official servers have been updated or will be updated once they have drained of players using the old version.
All other server owners have been notified about this update and will probably update their servers to the new version very soon.

You will not be able to find servers that haven't updated yet with the in-game server browser.
However, you will be able to find them using the Steam server browser, but trying to connect will yield a version mismatch error.
I recommend using the in-game server browser until all servers have updated.

Servers updated so far:
[list]
[*]SimRai
[*]Superfall Boogaloo!
[*]dr.N0s
[*]EMR
[*]Jim's
[*][ju:nien]
[*]karn's
[*]Knalltüten
[*]OurDare
[*]RIVINS
[*]Rudeflesh
[*]Tuijnenburg
[/list]

There's an unofficial community discord server, managed by slikktic and [L'SL] Lucasjlw™:
https://discord.gg/aycVCUDrXj

notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.3.1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

it's been a while since the last update, but here's a new one, finally!

The full changelog can, as always, be seen at:
https://github.com/BSVino/DoubleAction/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md

Highlights:
- Steam rich presence - Now your friends can see when you're falling to your death!
- Korean translation - Thanks to 스팀유저!
- Map-end votes should actually do something now - unless there's a server mod interfering with it :/
- All melee is now lag-compensated - previously only fistpunch melee was lag-compensated, and only if you left-clicked.
- Fast Weapon Switch (hud_fastswitch) now works as intended - no more extra clicks!

I've been holding off publishing this update for a while, since I didn't have contact data for many of the servers' admins and was looking for way to trigger auto-update mechanisms that people might or might not have.
However, with the recent closure of a bunch of servers, that number is down  to 1 server.

All other server owners have been notified about this update and will probably update their servers to the new version very soon.

On servers that haven't updated yet, there will be some issues with 3rd person crosshairs not pointing where they're shooting.
As a workaround until they update, switch to 1st person mode using the X key.

Servers updated so far:
- Superfall Boogaloo!
- SimRai
- Rudeflesh
- WELSHE
- EMR
- HomeRcide

Servers not updated:
- RIVINS (partially)
- Tuijnenburg (notified)
- Facemask (no contact info, disappeared)

notes.title: Double Action 1.3: I Said I'd Be Back!
notes.content:
What's this? A mini-map-emission for our most dedicated Boogalooers? Damn Straight.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7040760/bc94d1e6421e9873a787d272d9a0ab1851e4b1fb.jpg[/img]

Bring it in tight for the latest map from Doum - a prison-themed shoot-em-up in the vein of your favourite badass brawlers. With tight hallways to concentrate the boom boom and high ceilings to exacerbate the zoom zoom, this map is a welcome addition to the Double Action library. notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.2.2.2 (Update)
notes.content:
This server-side patch fixes a rounding error in the vote tallying system, leading to votes failing unless there is no counter-vote.

Windows and Linux Steam clients will also automatically update the local server component. This update is not necessary in order to effectively participate in votes.

Sorry for taking so long to catch this :)

PS: Again with apologies to people hosting hands-off servers on a Mac, we're only releasing this bug fix for Windows and Linux. Mac users can still join v1.2.2.2 servers with v1.2.2.

Update: Looks like i briefly broke the server browser. Should be working now.

notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.2.2.1
notes.content:
This patch fixes a couple of bugs in the voting system.

On the client side, effective immediately when downloading this update, there are two changes:
[list]
    [*]Prevent situations where there is a preselected choice that you cannot change.
    [*]In the "Call vote" menu, entries used to be invisible when selected. This has been fixed.
[/list]

On the server side, effective as soon as the server owner updates, there is 
[list]
    [*]Tied multiple-choice votes are no longer decided in favor of the topmost choice, but treated as if not enough players had voted.
[/list]

Onwards comrades, power to the people!

PS: With apologies to the Mac users among you, we're only releasing this bug fix for Windows and Linux. Mac users can still join v1.2.2.1 servers with v1.2.2.

notes.title: Double Action Boogaloo v 1.2.2
notes.content:
I love these rhyming version names.

That's correct! Double Action has received another slew of bugfixes and balances, changes and enhancements. 

Punters will notice some additions to the scoreboard, as well as upgrades to spectator mode. Bots can now mantle and climb in some spots, and the hitmarkers for incoming fire will now dynamically scale with game resolution, making for a clearer impact on larger screens.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7040760/a76ff32d8adf2eef1122970773f2f3abfe7c66eb.png[/img]

Our more experienced superfallers will notice that "WORTH IT!!" is now doled out less liberally, making for more intense and rewarding skybattles.

Additionally, gameplay has been tightened and bugs squashed, and the votekick system has received a tweakin. You can view the changelist [url=https://github.com/BSVino/DoubleAction/blob/develop/CHANGELOG.md]here[/url]

As usual, if you're making maps be sure to show us what you've got! Now get in there and RRRRRRUMBLE!

notes.title: Double Action: Boogaloo v1.2.1
notes.content:
That's right boogalooers it's bugfix time! TomyLobo has appeared out of the flames like Robert Patrick Jr in the final scenes of Terminator 2, delivering a chunky bunch of fixes to munch. Double Action has long been endeared with bugs ranging from the mundane to the insane, and this update smooths that ride leaving a clean guide for your styling-est slide.

TomyLobo is the living embodiment of community-borne awesomeness. Two months ago he popped up on the boogaloo radar with some nonchalant bugfixes and sensible github ideas and has since gone on to single handedly rejuvenate Double Action: Boogaloo with his select lines of code. Double Action has always relied on the skills of the people that play it, and will continue to do so into the future! If you can code, map, model, texture, sing, dance or stand on your head and move a box with the force, we want to hear from YOU! Get in contact via the community submissions forum on the DA steam discussions board, or add [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/brookesy]Stormy[/url] on steam!

As usual, server operatives will need to run the steam update on their various servers. The SimRai servers are up-to-date, as is the Through Human Eyes (T|H|E) server and Wizard of Distortions community server.

In this update:

[list]
[*]Akimbo weapons now drop one by one. Duallies too inaccurate all of a sudden? Don't want to spend all that time reloading two pistolas? Throw one away and get back into the action thanks to this fancy gameplay tweak.
[*]Overlapping slowmo now behaves properly. If you gain slowmo seconds during a slowmo activation, you can now disable your slowmo without re-activating the newly acquired slowmo seconds.
[*]Prevent switching to grenades when picked up. Few things suck more than trying to grab a local grenade only to find your weapon has disappeared and is being replaced by said grenade. That no longer happens, so now there's PLENTY of things that suck more than that!
[*]Fixed a bunch of ways to get stuck. Getting stuck is one of the few things that suck more!
[*]Don't update style skill until after a respawn. No more nitro sploits! You know who you are...
[/list]

And more bugfixes and changes. See the full changelog [url=https://github.com/BSVino/DoubleAction/blob/v1.2.1/CHANGELOG.md]here[/url]

Now it's time to kick bubble gum and chew some ass. And I'm all out of ass. See you on the servers this weekend ;)

notes.title: Name Polls Close Tomorrow + Upcoming
notes.content:
When polling began, Dive Harder was in a solid 20 point lead, but then in a surprising (and stylish!) reversal Doves of Fury pulled way ahead! Now Dive Harder is closing back in to again overtake Doves of Fury. Voting closes some time tomorrow (exactly what time? I dunno, whenever I feel like taking the poll down) so if you haven't already, get your vote in here: http://www.doubleactiongame.com/double-action-boogaloo-steam/

The Double Action team has been eating apples all week and the result is that the OSX version of DA is almost ready. Its bits and bytes are currently loaded into Steam and ready to be processed and downloaded by all of our beautiful players, we just have to do make sure none of the apples have any bugs before the hour of final disbursement (exactly what hour? I dunno, whenever we stop eating them apples.)

In addition we're going to release the OSX version in tandem with the Steam Workshop, which will let anyone build and distribute modifications to the game, some of which may be incorporated back into the official version. All of this will happen perhaps some time this weekend (exactly what day? I dunno, whenever it's done.)

EDIT: Sorry guys, looks like the workshop is going to take longer than we thought, it's coming soon, but not [i]as[/i] soon. We'll push forward with the Mac support, but workshop will be in a later update.

notes.title: Bugfix patch now available.
notes.content:
A patch is now available for Double Action that mades the following changes.

* In an effort to reduce the volume of grenades, grenades have been removed from the buy menu.
* Teamplay mode has been removed until it can be better polished.
* Added an indicator that helps highlight which weapon on the ground the player would pick up if E is pressed.
* Some of Brawl's situational bonuses have been reduced.
* Fixed a stuck bug related to sliding, and another stuck bug related to wall flipping.
* Some updated sounds.

Your Steam client should download the changes automatically. I appreciate any feedback from these changes so please leave your thoughts in our forums. We'll be continuing to apply fixes for balance issues and bug fixes to try to make the release process as smooth as possible.
